Date pickers: readable everywhere, and a complete time range picker

Screenshots of the real components: “Today” from the current docs site (feat/webkit-ai-ready 0dc12b196), “Proposed” from branch proposal/date-picker. Dark theme. The full write-up is packages/webkit/docs/reviews/date-picker-proposal.md.

Decision

  • Extend the existing DateRangePicker with options — no new component (a second “time range picker” would be a synonym, which the naming standard forbids) and no block (a block is a screen to copy; a picker must behave the same in every toolbar).
  • New value { type: 'since', start } (from a date until now), snapped ranges (Today, This week) with snap: true, auto refresh with show-refresh, v-model:refresh-interval and @refresh. Everything else keeps working.
  • Nothing is cut off: short tab labels, wrapping text, a compact label for a range inside one day. Checked by a test at 320, 390 and 1280 px in English and Portuguese.
  • Phones (below 640 px): both pickers open as a full-width sheet from the bottom over a backdrop, with 44 px touch targets.

Date range picker — trigger with step buttons

Today the label repeats the date and is cut with “…” in narrow boxes. Proposed: the date is printed once for a range inside one day, and the text wraps instead of being cut.

Phone 390 px

Date range picker — Relative tab

Today the tab reads “Absolute ran…”. Proposed: short tab labels, the custom duration always visible, quick ranges in two columns, the time zone on both tabs; on a phone a full-width sheet with big Cancel / Apply.

Desktop 1280 px

Phone 390 px

Date range picker — Absolute tab

Proposed adds “End at now” (a range from a fixed start until now, like the Console’s Now tab). The calendar is centred and the panel is a sheet on a phone.

Desktop 1280 px

Phone 390 px

New — auto refresh, Today and This week

show-refresh adds “Refresh every [1] [Minutes]”; the trigger shows a refresh icon. Today and This week start at the beginning of the day or week in the selected time zone.

New — a range that ends now

The value is { type: "since", start } and the trigger reads “Nov 10, 2026, 9:30 – now”. Next is disabled because the range already ends now.
